text:
kelly-sales: Hey team, Peregrine Trust wants a short POC. Must-haves: streaming + SSE fallback, structured function/tool-calls, JSON-LD schema versioning, on-prem connector (VPC), SAML SSO, offline KMS with HSM, and MQTT as a secondary fallback using mutual-TLS. Also need a quick pricing ballpark for ~120 qps steady, bursts to 600. Can presales assemble a one-pager + blockers list? :wave:

noah-eng: Interesting. They plan a Scala edge adapter and Elixir backend. We don't have a Scala SDK but standard HTTP/WebSocket patterns work. For MQTT mutual-TLS we'll provide a bridge spec (outbound-only TLS client auth).

kelly-sales: Edge will originate outbound connections only; security wants tokens short-lived.

indra-ml: Streaming rec: WebSocket primary, SSE fallback for proxies, MQTT fallback for flaky telco links. For toolcalls we emit incremental parts: e.g. a single-line stream event like {"evt":"tool.part","id":"p1","payload":{"name":"acct_get","partial":"{\"id\":\"...\"}"}} — include schema_version in every response for JSON-LD compatibility.

noah-eng: Ephemeral token header example (Scala pseudo): 
val req = Http(url).postData(body).header("Authorization", s"Bearer $token").header("X-Req-Id", reqId)
Rotate tokens ~5m; for MQTT use username=agent-id and client cert for MTLS, password=ephemeral-token.

security-bot: Note: recommend Dedicated if sustained >600 qps. Hosted handles bursts but unit cost is higher; see /pricing/dedicated-estimator. We'll share SOC2 + pen-test summary on request.

kelly-sales: Blockers checklist we can share with the customer?

noah-eng: 1) Network path: allowlist IPs or site-to-site VPN/VPC peering, or use the outbound MQTT/TLS bridge. 2) SAML metadata exchange + test IdP. 3) HSM/KMS test plan or temporary test creds. 4) acceptance prompt set + JSON-LD schema contract. 5) confirm model family for concrete cost estimates.

indra-ml: I'll prepare a tiny eval set that asserts schema_version and tool_call shapes and a JSON-LD example.

noah-eng: I'll draft the Scala snippets, MQTT bridge spec (MTLS + topic mapping), and a minimal runbook for WS/SSE/MQTT fallback. Share by EOD tomorrow.

kelly-sales: Perfect. I'll turn into a one-pager and ask Peregrine infra for SAML metadata and their cert rotation plan. Target POC start in ~2 weeks pending network/SAML. :calendar: :thumbsup:

[thread end]
